name: USG Tech Solutions Limited
about: USG Tech Solutions Limited engages in the provision of IT solutions and software project development services in India. It provides appropriate, transparent, and consistent data information management solutions; a range of integration services that include ECR integration, payment integration, platform integration, real time data analytics integration, and information integration; and data analytics, managed, mobility, and business process re-engineering services. The company also develops applications for multiple EFT POS devices, including mobile POS, web POS, terminal POS, and PC POS. It serves retail, aviation, health, and banking industries. The company was formerly known as V & K Softech Limited and changed its name to USG Tech Solutions Limited in August 2011. USG Tech Solutions Limited is based in Ghaziabad, India.
